Four seats returned only placeholder text and Kimi was rate-limited, so the council gives no substantive
answer on whether a single-node demo should use SQLite.
✓ finished: 4 of 5 answered, 1 error [ o · open pane ]
No real consensus can be drawn: the four responses are fake fixtures ("FAKE-…-RESPONSE: slow answer" and
"deterministic answer") and Kimi failed with a 429, so the question "Should a single-node demo use
SQLite?" remains unanswered by the council.
